name: Memory
source:
The heroine of a game that someone was playing. While she should've been nothing more than data, she suddenly attained consciousness. After someone who was important to her (perhaps the player?) disappeared without a word, she apparently started searching the remaining game world for "him".

She's a second-year student at High School A, located near Shibuya. In terms of personality, she's quiet and gentle. She apparently used to have a sharp and focused mind, but something happened to turn her forgetful and sloppy. She's been friends with Messiah since they were young, and they often hang out together after school.

While she's not the most proactive when it comes to making friends, she gets along with most people easily, whether that's because of her strong social skills or just because she's so easygoing. She can also be a bit odd, resulting in Messiah often struggling to keep up with her.
[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2943040]Steam[/url]]
